title: Panguna communities’ formal complaint over Rio Tinto mine impacts
reason: Formal complaint and conciliation process; no public gathering is reported, and the complaint filing predates the unit.
notes: The January 4, 2021 article states that 156 residents filed the complaint in September 2020 and the mediation process was accepted in November. It is not coded as a January protest.

title: Planned Hela landowners’ protest over PNG LNG payments
reason: The archive item is an announcement for a later 2021 protest, not evidence of a January gathering; the display-date format is ambiguous.
notes: Digital Pasifik metadata gives a display date of 10/05/2021 and says landowners planned to protest the following day. Only metadata was read, the video was not opened, and the actual gathering is unverified.

title: UPNG female students’ protest over sexual harassment
reason: The reported gathering began in June 2021, outside the January unit.
notes: The PNG Bulletin describes a small peaceful protest at Waigani campus directed at university administration. It is retained as an out-of-unit lead, not coded as a January candidate.

title: Opposition members’ parliamentary walkout
reason: The action occurred outside the assigned month and was a walkout inside Parliament, not a reported public mass gathering.
notes: The Post-Courier introduction says opposition members walked out over delayed parliamentary resumption. The article is dated November 22, 2021; event attendance is not reported.
